title: Allied Health Posts in Central Hospitals

value.body: AIIMS institutions and other central government hospitals recruit technologists and technicians for laboratories, radiology, operation theatres, dialysis, cardiology, optometry and other departments. These Group B and Group C posts support doctors in diagnosis and treatment. Eligibility is set post by post and usually matches a specific allied health qualification.

items.label: Main exam
items.note: Covers non-faculty Group B and C posts across several AIIMS and central institutes

items.label: CRE-5 vacancies
items.note: All posts, not only allied health

items.label: Typical eligibility
items.value: B.Sc or diploma in the matching specialty
items.note: Some posts also ask for experience or registration

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Hold the qualification named for the post — for example B.Sc Medical Lab Technology for laboratory posts or B.Sc Radiography for radiology posts. Apply through the AIIMS CRE (computer-based test, then skill test and document verification where required). Other central hospitals and bodies such as ESIC and the railways (RRB Paramedical categories) run their own notices.

value.title: At a glance
items: Eligibility is specialisation-specific — a general B.Sc rarely qualifies.
Vacancy numbers per post group are often small even when the total looks large.
Posts are usually in shifts, and postings can be at any participating institute.
